periods.time: Emergency summons from Bukyoku Academy to Fukuoka
periods.label: 天眼的紧急传送
periods.affiliation: Bukyoku Academy; International Mage-Knight League emergency response

status.current: supports Wakaba House and refugee evacuation after teleporting Moroboshi to Kyushu

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Teleports Moroboshi from Osaka to Kyushu under League summons.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Meets her after arriving and remains near evacuation operations.
relationships.toka-todo: Indirectly helps rescue her by delivering Moroboshi.

periods.summary: Jounosaki is specially summoned along with Moroboshi because his Teleport can rapidly deliver Moroboshi to Fukuoka. He transports them from Osaka to Kyushu in roughly five minutes, meets Kanata, and then stays with the evacuation side because no one is better at escaping and moving people than he is. His role is logistical but crucial: without his teleportation Moroboshi would not arrive in time to save Toka and Misogi from Tendo's first close-range assault.

key_events.summary: Enables Moroboshi's timely arrival by teleporting him from Bukyoku to Kyushu.
